responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend and offloading support for AMD GCN GPUs, covering both device code generation and the host-side tooling needed to build and run HSA code objects. Its core backend files define the GCN machine model, target hooks, ABI and calling conventions, address spaces, builtin functions, target options, and GPU device database, while the machine-description, predicate, and constraint families describe scalar/vector instruction selection, register classes, immediates, memory forms, and VALU-specific pattern generation for RTL expansion and assembly emission. Around that core, tree-level support implements GCN-specific OpenACC/OpenMP lowering such as reductions and LDS/shared-memory handling, pass registration connects those transformations into the compiler pipeline, and the HSA configuration, driver helpers, generated option/device tables, mkoffload builder, and gcn-run launcher handle offload-image creation, target-specific driver specs, embedded device metadata, and standalone execution of compiled kernels. Together, these files make this module the GCC subsystem responsible for compiling, packaging, and executing code for AMD GCN accelerators, distinct from generic middle-end optimization or non-GCN target backends.
